title: Judgement
description: What the agent concludes about one change request. The agent writes it into the work directory; the CLI validates it before finalizing.

headSha.description: Head commit the judgement refers to; it must match the work package.

summary.description: Optional overall remarks in Markdown, shown in the report.

findings.description: Problems the change introduces or exposes.

preExisting.description: Defects that already exist on the target branch. They are reported apart and change the verdict only when they are a crash.

signals.description: Decisions on the signals of the work package, by id. Every signal that needs judgement must be decided; a signal that does not becomes a finding unless it is dismissed here. Absent means no decisions.

questions.description: Questions for the author that the agent could not settle from the code. They appear in the report and are never published.

items.description: One question, optionally tied to a line.

line.description: Line the question is about, at the head commit.

notes.description: Short remarks for the report, at most three.

items.description: One remark of at most 200 characters.

notVerified.description: What the agent could not check, for example a behaviour that depends on code outside the change request.

items.description: One thing that was not checked.

finding.description: A problem in one place of the code, as judged by the agent.

path.description: File path in the change request; for a removed file, its old path.

side.description: Diff side that line and startLine refer to.

startLine.description: First line of a finding that spans several lines; absent for a single line.

title.description: What is wrong, in one line.

why.description: The consequence: what goes wrong if the code ships as it is, in Markdown.

fix.description: The smallest safe correction, in Markdown. A finding without a fix is not a finding.

suggestion.description: Replacement text for the lines from startLine (or line) to line, without a trailing newline.

references.description: Other places the finding relies on.

crash.description: True when the defect makes the app crash. Meaningful only in preExisting: an existing defect that crashes the app makes the change request BLOCKED. On findings of the change request it is rejected later by the judgement validation.

line.description: Line number, starting at 1, in the file version of the chosen side.

reference.description: Another place in the code that a finding relies on, possibly in another project.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA the line refers to.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes, without empty, '.' or '..' segments.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens, optionally in dot-separated groups, for example no-double-bang.

severity.description: Severity of a finding, from the most to the least serious.

sha.description: Full commit SHA, 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

side.description: Side of the diff: LEFT is the target branch version, RIGHT the change request version.

signalDecision.description: What the agent decides about one signal. A dismissed signal needs a reason and is listed in the report under the signals dismissed.

id.description: Id of the signal in the work package.

decision.description: confirm makes the signal a finding; dismiss drops it.

severity.description: Severity of the confirmed finding: required when the rule needs judgement, otherwise it overrides the rule's severity.

crash.description: True when a confirmed pre-existing signal makes the app crash; only with severity BLOCKER, checked by the judgement validation.

reason.description: Why the signal is dismissed, or a remark on a confirmed one.
